mines.mine_notes: Open pit heap-leach mine (Gold Bar, Gold Bar South, Pick III deposits), Eureka County, Nevada. Transitioned from higher-grade Gold Bar South to lower-grade Pick III; Q3/25 drilling reinterpretation improved Q4/25 output (+29% YoY). Revenue $116.7M in 2025. Costs per GEO sold. 2026 outlook guidance range disclosed in MD&A.

Underground mines (Black Fox, Froome) in Timmins, Ontario, processing at the Stock mill. No P&P reserves disclosed in the 10-K (resources only): Fox M+I resources 27.3 Mt @ 3.01 g/t Au (2.64 Moz) excl. reserves. Stock project ramp development advancing (~$29.5M invested 2025) targeting commercial production 2027; 2026 production outlook 16,000-19,000 GEOs (complex-level). Historic streaming at Froome/Black Fox ($611/oz for 2025). Q4/25 output impacted by weather-related closures. Costs per GEO sold. Timberline Resources acquired 2024 (Lookout Mountain resource, Nevada: 19.57 Mt @ 0.64 g/t Au indicated).

Sinaloa, Mexico. Residual 2025 production from heap-leach material reprocessing (91% dore, 9% slag/fine carbon). Construction decision reached for the Phase 1 heap-leach material reprocessing (Fenix) project in Dec 2025; EIA extension granted Dec 2025. El Gallo Silver resource separate (58 g/t Ag cutoff).

Underground gold-silver mine, Santa Cruz province, Argentina; operated by Hochschild via Minera Santa Cruz S.A. (MSC). 49% attributable figures shown. 100%-basis 2025: 118,612 GEOs produced; revenue $459.5M; production 13% dore / 87% concentrate. Gold/silver head grades -6%/-9% YoY; mill throughput +21% on new vertical mill (2,100 tpd). Attributable income from MSC investment $41.1M. Costs per GEO sold (100% basis). High local inflation pressure.

Large copper porphyry project (San Juan, Argentina) held via McEwen Copper Inc. (46.3% attributable P&P basis in 10-K). P&P reserves 473.7 Mt @ 0.453% Cu = 4,730 Mlb Cu attributable. No 2025 gold/silver production. Equity-accounted; 2025 share of loss $25.5M.

notes: FY2025 Form 10-K published March 17, 2026. Legal name McEwen Inc. (formerly McEwen Mining Inc.). Listed NYSE and TSX, ticker MUX on both. Consolidated 2025: 115,687 GEOs produced (94,476 oz Au, 1,833,226 oz Ag attributable), 113,732 GEOs sold; net income $34.4M. Silver-to-gold ratio 86:1 for GEO calc. Per-mine production from 10-K Item 1 table; costs are per GEO sold. Consolidated attributable P&P: ~0.3 Moz Au (Gold Bar + San Jose), 5.2 Moz Ag (San Jose), 4.7 Blb Cu (Los Azules). Attributable M+I resources: 3.93 Moz Au, 35.1 Moz Ag, 2.52 Blb Cu; inferred: 3.86 Moz Au, 79.1 Moz Ag, 9.3 Blb Cu. 486 employees (113 US, 30 Toronto, 213 Canada ops, Mexico 82 union). Chairman/CEO Robert R. McEwen.
